categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in functional materials and their application products, including functional adhesive films, new energy coated carbon foils, and carbon nanotubes. It serves industries such as 3C electronics, new energy vehicles, semiconductor, and home appliances. The business framework integrates functional material R&D with downstream application product manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include adhesive formulation, precision coating, nano-composite modification, and automated production lines for functional films and flexible flat cables (FFC). The company also develops advanced coating technologies for carbon foils and proprietary processes for carbon nanotube synthesis and purification. Manufacturing emphasizes high precision coating, automated assembly, and environmentally friendly processes like physical cutting for LED flexible circuit boards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in consumer electronics (e.g., Samsung, Foxconn), automotive manufacturers (e.g., Geely, Nissan, Great Wall Motors), lithium battery producers, semiconductor wafer manufacturers, and LED lighting companies. The company targets markets in 3C electronics, new energy vehicles, energy storage, semiconductors, and smart home appliances.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong, Henan, and Sichuan provinces. The company actively expands overseas markets, especially in Belt and Road countries including Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, South Korea, Turkey, and also established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong to develop Middle East, Africa, and Latin America markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, producing key functional materials and components such as adhesive films, flexible cables, coated carbon foils, and carbon nanotubes that serve as critical inputs for electronics, automotive, and battery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on technology leadership and innovation in functional materials, expanding into emerging fields like automotive electronics, new energy batteries, AI-driven server components, and advanced semiconductor materials. The company pursues a '1+N' collaborative R&D platform model, emphasizing nano-materials, precision coating, and smart manufacturing. R&D investment increased to 5.62% of revenue, with ongoing projects in high-temperature FFC films, battery pack FFC lines, sodium-ion battery coatings, and semiconductor UV protective tapes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of functional adhesive films, flexible flat cables, LED flexible circuit boards, coated carbon foils, and carbon nanotubes. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales to major customers, supplemented by buyout distribution channels. The company also earns government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position in functional adhesive films and related materials, breaking international monopolies in certain segments. It competes with Japanese and Korean firms in precision coating and adhesive technologies. In new energy battery materials and carbon nanotubes, it is rapidly growing to become a strategic pillar, leveraging technological breakthroughs and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 525.6 million, a 19.95% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 37.36 million, up 27.69%. Total assets grew 23.48% to RMB 1.45 billion. The company maintains steady growth with increasing R&D investment and expanding production capacity, especially in new energy materials.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation, high product quality, and customized solutions to meet demanding applications in high-frequency, high-temperature, and high-reliability environments. Its proprietary adhesive formulations, precision coating processes, and nano-material technologies provide superior performance in automotive electronics, new energy batteries, and advanced electronics. Environmentally friendly manufacturing and strong customer collaboration further differentiate its offerings.
